description: Repairs r-def-cursor-dao/prov-outer-join-absent-side: no CancelUpdate followed the failed Update, so the next Edit ran with a pending edit. A dynaset over a LEFT JOIN of PA to CH ("SELECT PA.ID AS PAID, PA.V, CH.ID AS CHID, CH.PID, CH.W FROM PA LEFT JOIN CH ON PA.ID = CH.PID ORDER BY PA.ID, CH.ID"; parent 3 has no child), inside BeginTrans and rolled back: Updatable, per-field DataUpdatable, SourceTable and SourceField; read all rows; MoveLast (the null-extended row); Edit, assign W 'new', Update, Errors, EditMode, then CancelUpdate, Errors, EditMode and read the row; Edit, assign V 'pv3', Update, Errors, EditMode, read the row, CancelUpdate when pending; AddNew, assign W 'added', Update, Errors, EditMode, CancelUpdate; Requery and read all rows; then COUNT(*) of CH and of PA. Asks what an edit of the child side of a null-extended row does, whether the parent side and AddNew are accepted, each from a state with no pending edit. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
